name: Neritic-Arete
description: Dust finer than flour pools in the low places, swallowing craters to their rims. Nothing has disturbed solar wind erosion patterns in a million years, and the dust keeps its surface smooth as held breath.
No wind, no voice, no weather: the landscape communicates in light and shadow alone, and it has plenty to say at sunrise.
The descent was survivable; what came after was not. Salvage rights to the starship crash site (colony ship) are contested by three claimants, two of them dead.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
